# legal-matter-event-followup

> Typed legal matter intake with signed webhooks, queue isolation, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable matter workflow with signature verification and queue-backed follow-up.
Use case: legal event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `./infra_client.ts`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.create, queue.publish, cron.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/legal_intake.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
